what: Only while scrolling, pictures (icons and photos) jolt between 0° and 10° every .25s with no in-between values (steps(1)) (yoyo repeat), and .15s after scrolling stops they settle to 0° over .3s. Giving each decorative icon a different angle (10, −3, 5°, photo 7°) makes the pictures bounce separately as the screen rolls.

options.idle: Delay after scrolling stops until settling (ms), default 150
